PortfolioConfig.title: PortfolioConfig
PortfolioConfig.description: Public portfolio header profile and CV collections (experience, education, skills, ventures, community service) managed exclusively by the verified portfolio owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version integer for forward-compatible portfolio metadata.

isPublished.description: Whether the portfolio configuration is publicly visible to visitors.

ownerEmail.description: Verified owner email address associated with the portfolio.

profile.description: Public architect monograph header, statement, contact links, and cover plate.

experiences.description: Chronological architectural internships and studio experience entries (max 40).

skillGroups.description: Categorized software and fabrication skill groups (max 25).

ventures.description: Design-build fabrication and property advisory highlights (max 25).

communityService.description: Volunteer leadership and community service records (max 30).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest owner update.

PortfolioProject.title: PortfolioProject
PortfolioProject.description: Individual architectural studio, climatic, BIM, or professional project with drawing plates.

id.description: Unique slug identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

category.description: Academic year or practice discipline filter category.

scale.description: Primary drawing scale or deliverable label.

tools.description: Software and fabrication methods used (1 to 20 entries).

highlights.description: Key project deliverables and achievements (1 to 20 entries).

featured.description: Whether the project is highlighted as featured.

plates.description: Ordered drawing plates with imageUrl, caption, plateNumber, and optional scale (1 to 30 entries).

isPublished.description: Visibility gate for public visitor queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

SketchItem.title: SketchItem
SketchItem.description: Hand-drawn observational sketch entry in the architectural sketch gallery.

id.description: Unique sketch identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

imageUrl.description: Static asset path or compressed data URL for the sketch image.

isPublished.description: Visibility gate for public visitor queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted allowlist record for additional admin UIDs (read-only from client).

/site_config/{configId}.description: Stores the singleton public portfolio document at /site_config/portfolio containing profile, CV experience, education, skills, ventures, and community service.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Stores individual portfolio project documents with plates and ordering metadata.

/sketches/{sketchId}.description: Stores individual hand-drawn sketch gallery documents.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Read-only admin membership registry used alongside the bootstrapped verified owner email.
